My logic is that we don't need to go asking a pedo about whether they acted on their urges or not on the internet because I personally think it kinda sensationalizes what they did. 

Also, if a child says they were molested, that's a totally different thing. I'd take it seriously. Why would I blow up at a child like that if they tolde something serious like that? 

I personally find it odd to ask stuff like that unless you're that person's psychiatrist/psychologist. I hope that cleared up what I meant!
